assets.copyright: Image created by Alan Blackwell on 8 Sept 2026 using Flux 2 Klein 9B Fast model, prompt: Looking straight down at the rough and eroded stone floor of a filthy abbatoir, the stone all reddish brown, completely washed over red and brown from overlaid residue of hundreds of floods, old drops and trickles, congealed pools and streaks of blood, tiny scraps of sinew and hair. Texture under flat dim ambience, no visible objects, shapes or highlights.

Image created by Alan Blackwell on 11 Sept 2026. Mask-edited with Palimpsest II, base image created using Flux 2 Klein 9B Fast model, prompt: The front panel of a small modular music synthesiser, with just four simple modules in a rack and patch cords between them.

Image created by Alan Blackwell on 11 Sept 2026 using Flux 2 Klein 9B Fast model, prompt: An old guitar pedal box, seen from above. It is battered and scratched, held together with large pieces of dirty and fraying duct tape. It's not really possible to see any of the original graphics or text, just fragments where the paint hasn't peeled off.

Image created by Alan Blackwell on 11 Sept 2026 using Flux 2 Klein 9B Fast model, prompt: A black bakelite knob with a position indicator poking out from one side. A remnant of a 1930s kitchen radio. Surface crazed, from years of fryer grime and cigarette smoke. Viewed from directly above, with uniform ambient lighting and no shadows, it sits alone on a matt black surface.
